_comment: Lock 4 of 4 on findability, for the Vercel case. public/_headers covers
Cloudflare Pages and Netlify; this covers Vercel. Both are shipped because
which host a concept ends up on is decided after the build, and the wrong
one silently means no header at all.
See public/robots.txt for the other three locks.

headers.value: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, noimageindex, notranslate
